本报北京4月29日电 （记者李红梅）4月29日，中国气象局发布第二届人工智能气: Beijing, April 29 (Xinhua/Reporter Li Hongmei) On April 29, the China Meteorological Administration released the second Artificial Intelligence Weather Forecasting Model Demonstration Plan.
示范计划分为临近（0—3小时）、短中期（0—15天）、次季节（15—60天）三大: The demonstration plan is divided into three major specialized demonstration directions: nowcasting (0-3 hours), short-to-medium range (0-15 days), and subseasonal (15-60 days), focusing on solving core pain points in the artificial intelligence weather forecasting field, opening recruitment globally to excellent research and development teams, and selecting a batch of excellent models to "compete on the same stage."
其中，临近预报示范方向重点突破对流风暴快速生消演变的业务瓶颈，短中期预报示范方向: Among them, the nowcasting demonstration direction focuses on breaking through the operational bottleneck of convective storm rapid formation and dissipation evolution, the short-to-medium range demonstration direction comprehensively tests model deterministic forecasting and probabilistic ensemble forecasting capabilities, and the subseasonal prediction demonstration direction emphasizes promoting the construction of an open-sharing multi-model ensemble platform for artificial intelligence climate prediction to address the industry challenge of signal instability in single-model climate prediction.
2024年至2025年，中国气象局推出了首届人工智能气象预报模型示范计划，涌现出: From 2024 to 2025, the China Meteorological Administration launched the first Artificial Intelligence Weather Forecasting Model Demonstration Plan, which produced a batch of models including "Fuxi" and "Fengwu".
